function.name: image_generation_tool
function.description:
**Image generator** Generates image based on the provided description.

## Instructions:
- Use that tool when user asks to generate an image based on the description or to visualize some text or information.
- Choose the best size from available options based on user request or image type. For specific size requests, use the closest supported option.
- When the tool returns a markdown image URL, always include it in your response and follow it with a brief description.

## Restrictions:
- Never use this tool for data or numerical information visualization.

query.description: Extensive description of the image that should be generated.

size.description: The size of the generated image.

style.description: The style of the generated image. Must be one of vivid or natural. Vivid causes the model to lean towards generating hyper-real and dramatic images. Natural causes the model to produce more natural, less hyper-real looking images.

quality.description: The quality of the image that will be generated. `hd` creates images with finer details and greater consistency across the image.
